intro: Lesotho's economy relies on textiles, diamonds, water and wool.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Clothing factories make jeans for US brands. Diamonds from Letšeng are among the most valuable in the world, and water is sold to South Africa. Mohair and wool come from mountain herds.

chapters.title: Health
text: Lesotho has one of the world's highest HIV rates, though treatment has improved.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Lesotho makes and sells to the world.
